observations: Photo 0 shows the rear derailleur, cassette, and part of the frame. The chain appears worn and slightly rusty. The rear wheel has a black rim with visible spoke tension. The frame is silver/white with some minor scuffs.

Photo 1 shows the front crankset and chainring. The crank arm is silver, and the chainring has 53 teeth. The bottom bracket area shows some dirt and wear. The frame has a white and silver design with a water bottle cage attached.

Photo 2 shows the full bicycle from above. It has drop handlebars, a black saddle, and a red-and-black bag attached to the seat post. The frame is silver/white, and the tires appear worn with brownish treads. The bike is parked on cracked concrete.
No brand or model name is visible on any part of the bike in the photos.
The seller claims 'ultra light weight aluminium frame', '53 teeth hollowtech crank', and '9 speed Tiger' groupset, but none of these are verifiable from the photos alone.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show visible dirt, grime, and rust on the chain, chainring, and bottom bracket. The frame also has scuffs and marks.
No material markings or frame ID visible. Weight cannot be assessed remotely. The frame appears to be aluminium based on color and design, but 'ultra light weight' is subjective and unprovable.
Photo 1 clearly shows a 53-tooth chainring. The crank arm has a hollow design consistent with Hollowtech, though the brand logo is not visible.
No visible branding on the derailleur or cassette to confirm 'Tiger' or 9-speed. The rear cassette in Photo 0 appears to have 9 cogs, but the brand is not readable.
